meta.title: Cheso Design
meta.description: Turn your ideas, files, and research into stunning presentations, posters, videos, and more. Create, edit, and share with Cheso

messages.loginDenied: Cheso denied the sign-in request. Get a new authorization link to try again.
messages.loginIncomplete: Cheso sign-in did not finish. Get a new authorization link.
messages.loginRequired: Sign in to Cheso to continue.
messages.loginInstructions: Authorize access in Cheso, then return here and select “Check sign-in”.
messages.loginEnterCode: Enter this code on the authorization page:
messages.loginExpired: This link has expired. Get a new authorization link.
messages.loginSignedIn: You’re signed in to Cheso. Send your previous request again.
messages.loginWaiting: Authorization is pending. Finish in Cheso, then check again.
messages.loginNotStarted: Sign-in hasn’t started or was canceled. Get a new authorization link.
messages.loginFailed: Could not sign in to Cheso. Try again.
messages.loginInvalidLink: Cheso did not return a valid authorization link.
messages.loginUnknownSite: This Cheso site is no longer configured. Check the site settings and try again.
messages.previewOpenFailed: Could not open the Cheso preview.
messages.previewLoginRequired: Sign in to the Cheso site that owns this file, then open the preview again.
messages.previewForbidden: Your Cheso account does not have access to this file.
messages.previewUnknownSite: Could not find the Cheso site for this file. List the project files again before opening the preview.
messages.previewSessionExpired: Your DSH session has expired. Reconnect and open the preview again.
messages.previewUrlRequestFailed: Could not get the file URL (HTTP {status}).
messages.previewReopen: Reopen the preview from a Cheso result card in the conversation.
messages.previewUnsupported: You can open this file in Cheso.
messages.previewInvalidEmbedUrl: The Cheso preview URL is invalid.
messages.previewTimedOut: The preview didn’t load. Select “Edit in Cheso”.
messages.previewFileStored: {name} is still saved in Cheso. You can open it there.
messages.settingsHelp: The selected site handles sign-in and new project requests. Each site keeps its own sign-in state.
messages.settingsStartupLocked: The site is set by the startup configuration.
messages.settingsFailed: Could not switch sites. Try again.
messages.accountHint: Connect your Cheso account to create results from chat. Each Cheso site keeps its own sign-in.
messages.accountSignedOut: Not signed in to this Cheso site.
messages.accountStatusFailed: Could not check the Cheso sign-in. Try again.
messages.accountInstructions: Finish in Cheso, then return here; the sign-in is confirmed automatically.
